craft_notes: Sthāyin: feed-and-watch (imperative pair). Sanskrit-first: indhana/dahana (FUEL/BURNING — kept; fuel-identity standard-marked per UNC). Rows: 9 (feed/watch pair — two imperatives), 1 (‘burn’ closes — fire last). Close: ‘watch it burn’. Rupture: em-dash (fuel offered, then fire). Rejected: ‘see’ — killed: watch keeps vigil; ‘consume’ — killed: burn burns. Read aloud: FEED-it EV-ery KNOW-a-ble — … WATCH-it-BURN.

reads_against.argmap: How is freedom won back? → Return by recognition, not effort: climb, burn, own, hold fast.
c1_essence: Return climbs, burns, owns, holds fast — freedom alive.
